parsed.note_claim: The labeling error originated on the UK VIDEX product, but the overdose and the deaths of the UK-origin owls occurred in Japan after they took the Japanese-made supplement.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: In 2021, 42 owls originating from the UK died after ingesting a Japanese-manufactured animal vitamin supplement. This product was modeled after the UK-made “MVS-30” by VIDEX Ltd. However, a labeling error on the original package listed “360gm” instead of the correct “360mg (milligrams).”
parsed.reason: The page backs the UK-origin owls, the VIDEX labeling error and the Japanese-made overdose, but it dates the deaths to 2021, which contradicts the note's 2024.
